Welcome to the official Living with Dogs with 'Abilities' YouTube channel, created for you by Upward Dog Rehab & Wellness.  We know it can be overwhelming when your dog has a painful injury or condition that affects their ability to be active and happy.

We want to empower you with the knowledge to help your dog lead an active life.

In addition to our video content, head to https://livingwithdogswithdisabilities.thinkific.com to download your FREE 👉 'Getting Started with Neuro and Orthopaedic Conditions at Home'

Additional videos and the chance to participate in live interviews with dog professionals, check out our Facebook community 👉 https://www.facebook.com/groups/LivingwithDogswithDisabilities

Our rehab therapist has a special interest in helping dog parents of dogs with degenerative myelopathy.  If that's you check out  👉 https://livingwithdogswithdisabilities.thinkific.com/courses/DMprogram2 

Thank you for subscribing! 🐾
